BAL.week6_result: L 10-13 at CLE (Oct 18). Second straight start for Tyler Huntley (19/31, 165 yds, 1 TD); offense stalled without Lamar Jackson. Ravens fall to 4-2. WR Rashod Bateman exited late in 2nd quarter (shoulder). Ravens.com headline references K Tyler Loop 'critical misses' (details not in snippet).

Schedule file listing Huntley is consistent with current reporting, but treat Jackson as a true game-time variable.

NYG.week6_result: L 27-34 vs NO (Oct 18). Jameis Winston (14/26, 152 yds, 1 TD, 2 INT) was benched in the 4th quarter for J.J. McCarthy, who went 11/21 for 243 yds, 1 TD, 1 INT as the Giants scored 17 late. CB Greg Newsome II (concussion), WR Darnell Mooney (neck) and LT Andrew Thomas (concussion eval, cleared) exited; LB Tremaine Edmunds hurt his shoulder on the final defensive play. Giants are 3-2-1.

qb.starter: UNDECIDED as of Oct 19 - J.J. McCarthy (reported lean) or Jameis Winston
qb.backup: Jameis Winston (if McCarthy starts); Jake Haener is QB3
qb.notes: HC John Harbaugh said Monday Oct 19 the staff is 'working through' and 'honing in on' the Wk7 starter and would not commit. Multiple outlets (ESPN, NBC, Big Blue View) read the non-answer as pointing to McCarthy, whose mobility is cited vs. Houston's pass rush. Harbaugh also said 'I have no problem with Jameis whatsoever,' so a Winston start is still possible. Schedule file lists Winston - flag as likely changed. Jaxson Dart (knee, MCL/meniscus surgery) is on IR for the regular season.
